accuracy_notes: Article 4 geometries were not treated as current parcel restrictions without linked direction, confirmation document, rule list and exact intersection.
Conservation-area data remained incomplete and duplicate-prone; alternative-source records were not promoted without authoritative local designation evidence.
Flood-risk zones were retained as probability screening geometry and not converted into definite flooding, depth, severity or parcel-risk conclusions.
Local-plan rows and boundaries were retained as research routing, not adopted site allocations, policy polygons or permissions.
Title-boundary index polygons were retained as indicative extents and not accepted as legally definitive canonical parcels.
No parcel relation, future-growth score or business row was fabricated.
